resources.string: No Apple Watch is paired with this iPhone.
Install Phase Wake on your Apple Watch in the Watch app.
Allow Phase Wake to set alarms so your iPhone can ring as a backup alarm.
For the sunrise, leave Phase Wake open on the charger overnight. The screen stays dark until the light begins.
Your iPhone can only show the light while Phase Wake is open – start nightstand mode before you go to sleep.
Sleep duration and regularity come from Apple Health.
Open Phase Wake before you go to sleep so your watch can arm the alarm.
Open Phase Wake on your Apple Watch before you go to sleep. watchOS only arms the alarm while the app is open.
First %1$d min not measured – the Apple Watch only measures the last %2$d min before the target.
